items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: You had that Yugoslavian, Goykovich... Yeah, he was one of the first players.

ctx.x: Well, I think the difference in the approach and the whole attitude of my big band today is that everybody plays fluegelhorn. Every trumpet player --
Yeah, yeah. You had that Yugoslavian, Goykovich. Dusko Gleicovitch (PHONETIC).
Yeah, he was one of the first players.
